name: Test Data Generator API
tagline: Generate realistic test datasets instantly. 12+ schemas, 10+ locales, custom fields.
description:
Test Data Generator API is a powerful, production-ready REST API for generating realistic, customizable test datasets. Perfect for development, QA testing, machine learning training, and demo environments.

Features:
- 12 pre-built schemas (Users, Transactions, Products, Orders, Medical Records, Banking, and more)
- 10+ locales (en_US, ru_RU, de_DE, fr_FR, ja_JP, zh_CN, and more)
- Custom field definitions
- Bulk generation support
- API key-based authentication
- Freemium pricing (100 free requests/day)
- Crypto payments accepted (USDT TRC20)

Use cases:
- Fill databases for development and staging
- Generate QA test data with realistic internationalization
- Create ML training datasets
- Populate demo applications
- Seed e-commerce, banking, and healthcare test environments
short_description: Generate realistic test datasets. 12 schemas, 10+ locales, custom fields. Free tier available.
